Bachelor's degree in biological sciences, neuroscience, biochemistry, or a related discipline, or equivalent education and research experience.
Hands-on experience with basic biological laboratory techniques gained through academic coursework or research training.
Experience with RNA extraction, qPCR, ELISA, Western blotting, immunofluorescence microscopy, or flow cytometry.
Experience using GraphPad Prism for basic statistical analysis and scientific graph preparation.
Prior research experience with laboratory mice and molecular/cellular assays.
Previous research experience in neuroscience, neuroimmunology, or related biomedical fields.
Previous experience handling laboratory mice and performing routine injections and tissue collection.

Under the general supervision of the Principal Investigator, Dr. Kwang-Mook Jung, the Staff Research Associate I (SRA I) will provide technical support for research projects investigating neuroinflammation, neurodegeneration, and related neurological disorders using mouse models. The incumbent will assist with animal experiments, tissue collection and processing, molecular and cellular assays, behavioral testing, imaging, and data analysis. The position requires careful experimental documentation, adherence to established laboratory protocols, and collaboration with other laboratory members.
Work involves handling live laboratory mice, including injections, euthanasia, and tissue collection, under approved animal care and use protocols.
Must complete required institutional animal care and use, laboratory safety, and biosafety training, and comply with associated regulations.
Basic knowledge of biological laboratory techniques and experimental procedures.
Familiarity with mouse behavioral testing and ANY-maze or similar behavioral analysis software.
Ability to follow established protocols and maintain accurate experimental records.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently under general supervision.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word and familiarity with basic scientific data analysis.
Ability to work effectively with laboratory personnel and comply with institutional safety and animal care requirements.
